items.description: M'bé Historic Site is linked to the royal history of the Téké people in central Congo. It is remembered as an important traditional and political center.
Case de Gaulle is a colonial-era site in Brazzaville associated with Charles de Gaulle and Free France. It remains one of the city's best-known historical addresses.
Sacré-Cœur Cathedral of Brazzaville is a major Catholic church in the capital. Its long presence makes it one of the city's important religious monuments.
Pointe-Noire Lighthouse is a coastal navigation landmark near the city's port area. It helped guide ships along the Atlantic shoreline.
The Old Brazzaville Railway Station is part of the city's CFCO transport heritage. It reflects the era when rail travel linked the capital to the coast.
The Old Boundji Mission preserves the memory of early missionary activity in the Cuvette region. It stands as a reminder of the area's religious history.
The Marien Ngouabi Mausoleum in Brazzaville honors the former Congolese president. It is an important memorial site in the capital.
